question.prompt: A class has the following blood types: 20 students with type A, 15 with type B, 10 with type O, and 5 with type AB. If a student is selected at random, what is the probability that the student has type O blood? (Express the result as a fraction in simplest form.)

solutions.explanation: There are \(20+15+10+5=50\) students in the class, of whom 10 have type O blood. The probability is \(10/50=1/5\).
solutions.title: Divide the type O count by the class total
